summary: RuleResult wraps evaluated output with backend-agnostic accessors: survivors, best_match, count, explain(), at_least().

key_classes.name: RuleResult
key_classes.summary: Wraps post-evaluation DataFrame. Provides survivors (full ranked set), best_match (top 1), count, explain(rule_name) (per-dim ternary), and at_least(n) (specificity filter).

extension_points: AccumulatorResult extends RuleResult with accumulator-specific accessors.
lifecycle_notes: explain() requires a 'rule_name' column in the rules DataFrame.
All accessors use mountainash.relations.Relation so they are backend-agnostic.
documentation_hooks: Document that survivors returns the native backend DataFrame — users can chain Polars/Ibis ops directly.
explain() is the primary explainability entry point — worth a dedicated section in user docs.
